acceptance: A full HTTPS GitHub repository URL is canonicalized once and is used both by release verification and by release-digests hydration; unsupported repository forms fail closed before target writes.

Focused regression tests cover a full HTTPS URL and prove the hydration URL resolves to https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template/releases/download/v0.5.57/release-digests.json rather than a nested invalid URL.
Strict local quality and same-SHA hosted rehearsal pass without lowering tests, coverage, security, installer, or release gates.
The actual v0.5.57 Release has an immutable tag, source-bound archive, SBOM, provenance, installer digest, and release-digests correlation that match its workflow receipt.

A fresh Git repository using v0.5.57/install.sh with AI_COCKPIT_TEMPLATE_REPO=https://github.com/spirex-ds-dev/ai-cockpit-template.git installs successfully and records the v0.5.57 identity before target writes; only then may #783 be closed.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: v0.5.56 correctly normalizes a full public GitHub URL for release verification, but install.sh separately constructs its release-digests asset URL from the unnormalized input. The public black-box installer therefore fails with HTTP 404 after verification and before target writes, so future adopter projects using a full HTTPS URL cannot receive the delivery.
constraints: Preserve all immutable historical releases including v0.5.56.
Do not weaken coverage, tests, security, release, or evidence gates.
Use only source-bound release receipts and actual public black-box installation proof.
The user authorized necessary confirmations and requires complete local and remote cleanup.
intent.rationale: A single canonical repository identity removes divergent URL construction while retaining fail-closed validation. Because v0.5.56 is immutable, a new patch release with independent evidence is the only truthful delivery route.
